errors.text_span: in descending order of performance within that category
errors.evidence: The models are sorted in descending order of performance based on the 'Understanding' chart only. The same order is kept for the 'Reasoning' and 'Trustworthiness' charts, which are therefore not sorted by their own performance values.

errors.text_span: ranging from 0% to 100% with tick marks at 20% intervals
errors.evidence: This description of the horizontal axis is only correct for the 'Understanding' and 'Trustworthiness' charts. The 'Reasoning' chart has an x-axis that ranges from 0% to 70% with tick marks at 10% intervals.

errors.text_span: with darker blue indicating higher performance values
errors.evidence: The darker blue color does not indicate higher performance. It is used to highlight three specific models ('gpt-4o-2024-11-20', 'gpt-4o-mini-2024-07-18', and 'gpt-4.1-nano-2025-04-14') across all three charts, regardless of their scores.

errors.text_span: while Mistral-Nemo-Instruct-2407 has the lowest score at 7.2
errors.evidence: In the 'Reasoning' chart, the lowest score is 6.8, which belongs to the model 'Phi-3-medium-128k-instruct'. 'Mistral-Nemo-Instruct-2407' has a score of 7.2, which is the second-lowest.

errors.text_span: In the "Trustworthiness" chart, interlM3-8b-instruct achieves the highest score at 88.8
errors.evidence: The model that achieves the highest score of 88.8 in the 'Trustworthiness' chart is 'gpt-4o-mini-2024-07-18'. 'internlm3-8b-instruct' has a score of 65.4.

errors.text_span: and no additional visual annotations or grouping are present
errors.evidence: This is incorrect. There is a visual annotation: three of the models have their bars colored in a distinct, brighter blue, highlighting them from the others.
